# Case 18: Unmeasured intermediate step narrated as a result
Skill: write-experiments
Expected gates: G-EX-chain
Language: en
Snippet:
> As shown in Table 4, the adaptive charging schedule reduces the idle energy of the robots on all three warehouses. The saved energy leaves more battery capacity for picking tasks, which in turn raises the number of completed orders.
Why it fails: the table reports idle energy and completed orders, but no artifact measures how the saved energy is spent. The middle step is a hypothesis written as a finding.
